paragraphs.text: Sign in with ChatGPT on deepseek harness
# dsh-SIWC
Sign in with ChatGPT on deepseek harness
The current package is `@f12o/dsh-siwc@0.1.0-alpha.5`, published on npm under the `alpha` dist-tag,
with source and setup guidance in `packages/chatgpt`. The preserved v5 artifact under the former ide
ntity `@f4ah6o/dsh-chatgpt@0.1.0` is historical only. This repository has no build-time dependency o
n a sibling DeepSeek Harness checkout.
The package declares compatibility with the DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.1` through `0.2.1-alpha.4
`, and `0.2.1-rc.2` API lines and their corresponding Cordis runtimes. Its build uses the published
Typert generator with the narrow pinned patch in `patches`; the package tests check the generated Ho
st Remote contract and OAuth lifecycle, while `pnpm run build` also builds the lazy Client entry poi
Remote contract and OAuth lifecycle, while `pnpm run build` also builds the lazy Client entry point.
Run `pnpm install`, `pnpm run build`, and `pnpm test` from this directory. Profile requirements, acc
ount setup, headless browser sign-in, and model configuration are in the package README. Release ope
rators can follow the npm publishing guide.
